title: Starry Farm Landscape
description: A serene rural landscape at night featuring a golden wheat field in the foreground, a red barn and scattered trees in the midground, all under a vibrant starry night sky filled with the Milky Way and glowing nebulae. The entire scene is enclosed within a thick, textured painterly frame with swirling impasto strokes of deep blue, purple, and gold.
